description: Pins on ports A, H, J, K and L of the Mega 2560 (extended I/O addresses), PWM on timer 4 and 5, ADC channels above 7.
basis: digital_pin_to_port_PGM of the mega variant (22 = PA0, 42 = PL7, 7 = PH4, 15 = PJ0, 62 = PK0) and the datasheet: an OUTPUT keeps its level, INPUT_PULLUP reads HIGH, an open INPUT reads LOW (model assumption of plan 4.8); analogWrite sets OCR4C (pin 8) and OCR5A (pin 46) to the value; ADC = floor(Vin * 1024 / 5 V): 1.5 V on A8 -> 307, 4 V on channel 3 -> 819
